contradictions: The operator's own disclosed licensing claims (Gibraltar RGL 010/012 for the international ladbrokes.com product, UKGC account 54743 for the GB ladbrokes.co.uk product) do not include any Spanish DGOJ authorisation, yet the target URL is a live, apparently unrestricted ladbrokes.com page reachable via a standard request — this session's own fetch attempts returned HTTP 403 (consistent with bot-protection rather than confirmed geo-blocking), so it could not be established live whether Spain-based users are actually blocked or can reach the site, which is the crux of the enforcement question.

The Ladbrokes/Entain group does hold a legitimate DGOJ licence in Spain through a related joint-venture brand, Sportium (with Cirsa), and historically through 'LBapuestas' (Ladbrokes Internacional, PLC) — this creates a plausible source of consumer/regulatory confusion between the licensed Spanish JV brand and the unauthorised global ladbrokes.com domain, which are legally distinct operators.

A UK Companies House entity named 'LC INTERNATIONAL LTD' (company no. 11507998) surfaced in searches alongside the Gibraltar-registered 'LC International Limited' (company no. 46808) that the UKGC register and Gibraltar filings associate with the Ladbrokes brand; direct verification of any relationship between the two was blocked by 403 errors on Companies House, so this remains an unresolved naming overlap rather than a confirmed link.

All direct WebFetch attempts against ladbrokes.com, gamblingcommission.gov.uk, gibraltar.gov.gi PDF documents, ordenacionjuego.es, whois.com, and Companies House returned HTTP 403 in this session; every finding above is therefore built on search-engine-indexed snippets/aggregator sites rather than a live, first-hand read of the primary source, and should be independently re-verified by an analyst with direct register access before being relied upon for enforcement action.
analystNotes: Ladbrokes (ladbrokes.com) is a well-documented, long-established international sportsbook brand operated by LC International Limited, a Gibraltar-registered company (no. 46808) that is part of Entain plc (incorporated Isle of Man, FTSE 100-listed). The brand holds active Gibraltar remote gambling licences (RGL 010 and RGL 012) covering non-GB customers, and a separate UK Gambling Commission licence (account 54743) covering GB customers via the sibling ladbrokes.co.uk domain. No evidence was found of any Spanish DGOJ authorisation held by LC International Limited or covering the ladbrokes.com domain; secondary sources consistently describe ladbrokes.com as blocked for Spanish residents, who are directed instead to Sportium.es, a separately DGOJ-licensed joint venture between the Ladbrokes/Entain group and Cirsa (and historically also 'LBapuestas'/Ladbrokes Internacional PLC). This is a textbook parent/licensee structure rather than an unknown or shell operator: the ultimate parent (Entain plc) is a large, publicly listed, heavily regulated group with a substantial recent history of AML and responsible-gambling enforcement actions in other jurisdictions (Australia/ACMA and AUSTRAC, UK historical AML fine, Denmark marketing fine), which is useful context on the group's compliance record even though those specific actions concern different national licensees (chiefly Ladbrokes AU) rather than LC International Limited directly. The single largest limitation of this investigation is tooling: every direct WebFetch attempt against the target site, the UK and Gibraltar gambling registers, the Spanish DGOJ register, Companies House, and WHOIS lookup pages returned HTTP 403, so no fact here was confirmed by a first-hand page read — all conclusions rest on WebSearch-returned snippets and aggregator/mirror sites, which is a materially weaker evidentiary basis than a direct register query. Recommended next steps for the case team: (1) obtain direct (non-bot-blocked) access to ordenacionjuego.es to run a live operator-name/domain search for 'Ladbrokes' and 'LC International Limited'; (2) obtain a live geo-located test (from a Spanish IP) of whether https://www.ladbrokes.com/en/sports/sport/cricket actually serves Spanish visitors or redirects/blocks them, since this determines whether the case is about live unauthorised access or a stale/theoretical exposure; (3) resolve whether UK company 11507998 ('LC INTERNATIONAL LTD') is related to the Gibraltar entity of the same name.
